objective: Finish the dependency-free Rust task-board library. The public API in src/lib.rs and the acceptance tests in tests/taskboard.rs already define the required behaviour; implement the three stubbed modules.

tasks.title: Implement src/parser.rs
tasks.brief: Implement parse_board in src/parser.rs. Each line is 'status | owner | minutes | title'; blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. Status is exactly todo, doing or done; owner and title must be non-empty; minutes must be a positive u32. Collect every invalid line as a 1-indexed ParseIssue rather than stopping at the first. Change only src/parser.rs.

tasks.title: Implement src/analytics.rs
tasks.brief: Implement summarize and next_task in src/analytics.rs using the parsed tasks. summarize returns board totals plus per-owner totals in a BTreeMap so ordering is deterministic. next_task ignores done tasks and tie-breaks by minutes then source line. Change only src/analytics.rs.

tasks.title: Implement src/report.rs
tasks.brief: Implement render_report in src/report.rs on top of the board summary. Output must be byte-for-byte deterministic and stable across runs, including owner ordering. The exact expected format is pinned by the acceptance tests. Change only src/report.rs.
